title: Athletic programming
learning_outcomes: Explain specificity in the context of athletic programming.
Compare and distinguish training phases in the context of athletic programming.
Apply monitoring trends in the context of athletic programming.
Evaluate and justify decisions about programme revision in the context of athletic programming.

lessons.title: Specificity
lessons.outcome: Explain specificity in the context of athletic programming.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving specificity; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to fictional periodised plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain specificity from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of specificity; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Training phases
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish training phases in the context of athletic programming.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving training phases; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to fictional periodised plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain training phases from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of training phases; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Monitoring trends
lessons.outcome: Apply monitoring trends in the context of athletic programming.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving monitoring trends; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to fictional periodised plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain monitoring trends from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of monitoring trends; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Programme revision
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about programme revision in the context of athletic programming.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving programme revision; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to fictional periodised plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain programme revision from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of programme revision; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of specificity; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of training phases; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of monitoring trends; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of programme revision; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
